sources.title: LiteRT-Models/ormbg at main · john-rocky/LiteRT-Models · GitHub
sources.snippet: Real-time background removal running fully on the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU. ormbg is a fully open, Apache-2.0 foreground/alpha matte model (an ISNet trained for photorealistic subject cut-out) — the permissively-licensed alternative to the non-commercial RMBG-1.4. ~10 ms/frame on a Pixel 8a.
